## Appearance

Harris is a bold young woman who features a massive, hanging pompadour. She is further distinguished by her large, roving brown eyes and an exceptionally broad, dazing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Obed Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_

## History

Harris was hired by her uncle by marriage, [Samuel](../character/samuel.md) Lawson, to work as a female clerk during a period of growth in his trade. When [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) visited Samuel's store in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford) to buy a new gown for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), he failed to realize that Harris had been employed there.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Obed Insists on Puffed Sleeves P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Obed Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Obed Insists on Puffed Sleeves P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXV.
